title: Something went wrong
generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
requestIdHelp: Quote this reference if you report the problem.

code.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some of what you entered could not be accepted.
code.FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to that.
code.CONFLICT: That conflicts with something already recorded.
code.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
code.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
code.MARKET_DATA_UNAVAILABLE: Market data is unavailable right now. Figures fall back to cost.
code.MARKET_DATA_RATE_LIMITED: The market data limit has been reached. Prices will refresh shortly.
code.MARKET_DATA_TIMEOUT: The market data provider did not respond in time.
code.MARKET_DATA_NOT_CONFIGURED: No market data provider is configured.
code.MARKET_DATA_INVALID_RESPONSE: The market data provider returned something Stockly could not read.
code.AI_UNAVAILABLE: Stockly AI is unavailable right now.
code.AI_RATE_LIMITED: Too many questions in a short time. Please wait a moment.
code.AI_TIMEOUT: Stockly AI did not respond in time.
code.AI_INVALID_RESPONSE: Stockly AI returned something that could not be shown.
code.AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: You have reached today's limit for Stockly AI.

network: Stockly could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Stockly needs a connection to show your portfolio. Your data is safe — this page will work again once you are back online.

notFound.title: Page not found
